d: Our client is an organizational development consulting & training firm, helping leaders build organizations that thrive. They work with leaders to make better decisions and implement sustainable change. Their not your average firm; they embrace the unconventional.

While their brand is dynamic, spirited, and bold, their insights are sharp and rooted in academia and expertise, and their opinions where relevant. They create content not only to build their brand but also (and more importantly) to create value in the world. They know that not everyone can hire them as consultants, so they have a yearly goal of sharing their knowledge with the world through articles, videos, worksheets, templates, checklists, resources, and reports.
They are a fully remote team of Consultants who are high-performing, happy and committed to building a company for the ages.

They are looking for a B2B Marketing Executive to help grow the company and bring their work, ideas and expertise to the right audiences across the GCC. This is a hands-on role spanning the full marketing funnel. You will plan and execute campaigns, create content, support events and lead-generation initiatives, manage our ongoing marketing channels, and use data to continuously improve what we do.
q: Excellent English writing and editing skills
Fluency in Arabic and English preferred
Experience planning and executing B2B marketing campaigns
Strong content creation skills and a good eye for design
Experience with email marketing, social media, and digital campaigns
An understanding of lead generation, nurture, and conversion
Comfort working with marketing analytics and translating data into insights
Confidence using AI tools and curiosity about marketing automation
Strong project management and organizational skills
An understanding of the GCC business environment
The ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a remote team
Experience in professional services, consulting, HR, learning & development, B2B technology, or an agency environment is an advantage.
r: Plan and execute integrated B2B marketing campaigns across our services, programs and thought leadership
Develop campaign concepts, messaging, content plans and creative direction
Create content and visuals for social media, email, web and other channels
Support the development of articles, reports, presentations and other thought leadership
Develop creative assets using Canva and support the production of video content
Support our podcast, webinars and other content formats
Identify opportunities for timely and relevant content around regional and industry conversations
Support PR and speaking opportunities that strengthen the visibility of the company and our experts
Support marketing for events, roundtables and experiences in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and across the region
Develop event invitations, landing pages, email campaigns, downloadable resources and follow-up content
Create lead-generation assets including case studies, landing pages and targeted email campaigns
Manage our newsletter, from content and production through to distribution and performance
Help nurture our audiences from initial awareness through to engagement and qualified opportunities
Track performance across campaigns, content, email, events and other channels
Build regular marketing reports and translate data into useful insights
Identify what is working, what isn't and where we should experiment
Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance
Support the evolution of our marketing strategy as the business grows
Use AI and automation to make our marketing operations more effective and efficient
Maintain a high standard of quality and consistency across our marketing
Create and maintain templates and marketing assets
Support the evolution of our brand and editorial guidelines
Work across the business to support strategic initiatives and bring them to market

d: Qiddiya is seeking an experienced utilities leader to direct the safe, reliable and cost-effective delivery of district cooling and gas services across its assigned portfolio.

Reporting to the Senior Director – Utilities, you will lead managers, technical specialists and service providers, overseeing plant and network performance, system integrity, operational readiness and lifecycle planning within agreed asset and service boundaries.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Energy or Process Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in district cooling, gas utilities, plant operations, engineering or asset management, including at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing complex plants, networks or service-provider portfolios.
Leadership experience in district cooling or gas utility operations and maintenance, with relevant exposure to both cooling and gas services .
Experience managing specialist operators, contracts, operating budgets, capacity constraints and lifecycle renewals.
Experience transitioning plants and networks into live operation and coordinating outages, emergency arrangements and operational recovery.
Relevant postgraduate qualification in utilities, engineering management or asset management.
Professional engineering registration or chartered status.
Relevant certification in district cooling, gas operations, asset management, maintenance or process safety.
r: Translate utilities strategy into operating plans, maintenance programmes and measurable service standards.
Direct operation and maintenance of adopted district cooling plants, associated distribution assets and customer interfaces.
Hold specialist providers accountable for gas storage, handling and distribution operations, inspections and maintenance.
Oversee safety, compliance and system-integrity assurance with authorised technical specialists.
Assess cooling demand, gas supply requirements, capacity and resilience, recommending improvements and lifecycle investments.
Coordinate shutdowns, emergency arrangements and service recovery with operators, customers and response teams.
Lead operational readiness and handover reviews, including commissioning evidence, asset information, defects and warranties.
Manage teams, service-provider performance, approved budgets, procurement inputs and executive reporting.

d: We are seeking an experienced Project Manager – Fit-Out & Landscaping to lead and manage the delivery of architectural fit-out, finishing and landscaping works across large-scale development projects.

The role requires a strong background in architectural works, interior fit-out and landscape construction, with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams, consultants, contractors and stakeholders.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Landscape Architecture or a related discipline. An Architecture or Landscape Architecture background is preferred.
Minimum 10 years of overall professional experience, with substantial experience in project management.
Proven track record in managing architectural fit-out and landscaping projects.
Strong experience in high-end interior fit-out, architectural finishes and external landscaping works.
Experience delivering large-scale hospitality, residential, commercial, mixed-use or public realm developments.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple contractors, consultants, multidisciplinary teams and project stakeholders.
Strong knowledge of project planning, budgeting, cost control, procurement, contract administration and risk management.
PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification is preferred.
Professional registration with a relevant engineering or architectural authority is an advantage.
Strong understanding of architectural and landscape design coordination.
Proficiency in project planning, reporting and construction management systems.
Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
Proven project management experience in fit-out and landscaping works.
Strong architectural construction and interior finishing knowledge.
Direct experience managing hard and soft landscaping packages.
Experience coordinating architectural, MEP, civil and landscape disciplines.
Successful delivery of large-scale development projects within approved budgets and schedules.
r: Lead the planning, execution and delivery of fit-out and landscaping projects, ensuring compliance with approved project schedules, budgets and quality requirements.
Develop and monitor project execution strategies, construction programmes, resource plans and delivery milestones.
Manage contractors, subcontractors, consultants and suppliers throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor project progress, identify potential risks and implement mitigation measures to ensure timely delivery.
Manage project budgets, cost control, variations, procurement and contractual obligations.
Provide regular progress reports, project updates and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders.
Oversee the delivery of interior and exterior fit-out packages, including high-end architectural finishes, flooring, ceilings, wall finishes, joinery, doors, partitions and specialist installations.
Coordinate architectural design requirements, shop drawings, material submittals and technical approvals.
Ensure fit-out works are executed in accordance with approved design intent, specifications and quality standards.
Manage mock-ups, material inspections, quality inspections, snagging and defect rectification.
Coordinate fit-out activities with structural, civil, MEP and specialist contractors to ensure seamless integration.
Manage the execution of hard and soft landscaping packages, including paving, walkways, planting, turfing, irrigation and public realm development.
Oversee landscape contractors and ensure works are implemented in accordance with approved landscape designs and specifications.
Manage irrigation systems, drainage, soil preparation, tree planting, turf establishment and other landscape-related activities.
Coordinate landscaping works with civil infrastructure, utilities, architectural and external development packages.
Monitor landscape quality, material compliance, workmanship and overall project delivery.
Coordinate with design consultants, architects, landscape architects and engineering teams to ensure design requirements are properly translated into construction deliverables.
Review and coordinate architectural and landscape drawings, specifications, technical submissions and construction methodologies.
Identify design discrepancies, technical issues and interface clashes and ensure timely resolution.
Monitor design changes and assess their impact on project scope, programme and cost.
Ensure compliance with approved project specifications, applicable codes, quality standards and HSE requirements.
Implement project quality management procedures and monitor contractor compliance.
Lead progress reviews, site inspections, testing, snagging and defect rectification.
Manage project completion, documentation, handover and close-out activities.
